multi_entity_note: Three parties: NFLA-NC, NFLA, and Food For Athletes / Gridiron BioNutrients (the Company).
processing_note: All notices or submissions to be made or delivered by the Company, the NFLA or the NFLA-NC pursuant to this Agreement shall be delivered to the agent's address below, free of all charges (for example, shipping charges and customs charges).

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement was made and executed on October 30, 2017; November dates are the contract period, 12/6/2017 is the filing date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section Twenty: governed by the laws of California; other 'California' occurrences are incorporation, chapter names or arbitration location.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement only says the parties will begin renewal discussions; no renewal term length is stated.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no automatic renewal and no notice period to prevent renewal.
